name: @agentry/workbench-server
description: The Agentry Workbench local service — the file-watching Node server the /agentry:workbench command spawns, shipped as a committed zero-install bundle at plugin/workbench/server/index.js. Phase 0: a minimal node:http server answering GET /healthz; the ports-and-adapters tree (domain/application/persistence/transport/instance) lands in Phase 1+.
